notes.title: BIG ANNOUNCEMENT FOR THE FUTURE OF THE GAME
notes.notes:
🚨 BIG ANNOUNCEMENT 🚨

We’re thrilled to announce that Project Solar is now a CO-OP GAME! 🎉👾

We’ve been working non-stop to bring you the ultimate co-op puzzle adventure experience, and we're just getting started. The journey with R.A.Y. and P.I.P has evolved into something even more exciting, and we're bringing you along for the ride!

🔍 Sneak peeks and news are dropping regularly, and you can catch all the latest updates and behind-the-scenes action in our Discord community:
👉 Join our Discord now! 👈

🚨 And there’s more! 🚨
We’re gearing up for a BIG CLOSED PLAYTEST, and YOU could be one of the first to try out the co-op version of the game! 🙌✨

This is your chance to team up with a friend, solve puzzles, and explore the mysteries of the solar punk world together before anyone else!

👉 Want in? Head over to our Discord and stay tuned for more details on how to sign up for the playtest!

Let’s unlock this adventure together! 💥

notes.title: Thank you for the thousands of people who playtested the game!
notes.notes:
Thank you all for your incredible support! Today, we’re announcing that the Project Solar technical demo has officially been removed from Steam. Over the past weeks, thousands of you have explored our world, tested the game, and shared valuable feedback. We’ve carefully gathered all your insights, and they’ll be instrumental in shaping the final version of the game. We’re incredibly grateful for your feedback and enthusiasm.

We also want to take a moment to thank everyone who has added Project Solar to their wishlists. The overwhelming amount of support, with thousands of wishlists, has left us truly humbled. We never imagined receiving such a massive response, and it feels surreal to see so many of you excited about the project. Your support means the world to us, and we can’t thank you enough.

Now, as we move forward, we’ll begin working on the full game, and that includes some exciting new developments—like co-op gameplay, which we haven’t yet shown in the demo. Our goal is to make the co-op experience as engaging and immersive as possible, allowing you to tackle challenges together with a friend in a dynamic way.

The next time you get your hands on Project Solar, it’s going to be something truly special. With your feedback and our continued development, we’re confident the game will be even more polished, immersive, and filled with new surprises.

Thank you once again for all your support. We’re beyond excited to share the next steps of this journey with you, and we can’t wait to show you what’s in store!

notes.title: OOPS!
notes.notes:
We accidently made a bad with the top down camera when pushing that made it super weird and super unintuitive to do the radio building puzzle. We have now fixed that in this build! 

Thank you for the playtest and quick feedback!

notes.title: The First Update is here!
notes.notes:
We’re excited to share the latest update for Project Solar with several important improvements:

Gamepad Support: A major addition! Full gamepad support is now available, allowing for a more immersive gameplay experience.
Quality of Life Updates: Various tweaks have been made to enhance the overall smoothness and enjoyment of the game.
Bug Fixes: We've addressed numerous bugs to improve overall stability and performance, ensuring a more polished experience.
UI Updates: New UI elements and technology have been introduced for a better visual experience and enhanced user interface.
Localization: We’ve implemented the first stages of localization to make the game accessible to a broader audience.
Design Adjustments: Gameplay design has been refined to create a more balanced and enjoyable experience.
A heartfelt thank you to our incredible community! Your feedback has been invaluable, and we are grateful for the overwhelming support from everyone who has played and wishlisted Project Solar. It’s your enthusiasm and dedication that inspire us to keep improving and expanding this world. We can’t wait for you to experience the changes in this patch!

notes.title: Video Issues
notes.notes:
If you have had issues where your demo playthrough has ended with a blackscreen, it is not intended. We have gotten reports that some players have encountered this issue.

if you are one of them please email your speccs and what settings you where playing on in game: info@imperialplaygrounds.com

thank you for your understanding we are working hard to fix the issue!
